Neha / Karthik — reviewed with AP. We can make a limited weekly invoice exception for Meditrust for the pilot under these controls: 

- Condition: weekly invoices accepted only if each invoice is <= $50,000 and backed by an active signed PO covering the period (we will require PO number on every invoice).
- Pre-auth: Procurement must confirm a weekly funding window (email confirmation on the PO or a standing purchase commitment).
- Fee cadence: we will bill Net 45 by default; we can offer Net 30 if the account signs up for an early-pay 1.5% discount or provides a pre-funded spend bucket.
- Invoice format: we require header fields PO-ID and billto_department exactly as in the attached mapping. AP prefers CSV export for bulk ingest (we’ll accept PDF + CSV).

If Meditrust needs strict Net 45, that’s fine — but weekly runs may create cash timing gaps on our side. Karthik, please negotiate the early-pay discount option — that may be an easy win for both sides.
